title: When Credit Turns Against Tools: Transition-Aware Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Derivation and training/evaluation on Qwen models and benchmark tasks support a specific observation that terminal-reward normalization can give negative aggregate credit to tool tokens; TACA performance is separate from this represented mechanism. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: The paper analyzes multi-turn language-model reinforcement learning and uses Transition-Aware Credit Assignment (TACA), with Advantage Projection, Decision Contrast and supervised replay, to address negative credit assigned to tool-call tokens.
